h1: Residency Holiday Call Schedules, Built For You
paragraph: Stop spending hours on the holiday call schedule. Submit your rules to Scheduling Wizard; we deliver a fair, ACGME-compliant schedule for your residency.

cta.title: Get Your Holiday Call Schedule Right
cta.description: Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have Scheduling Wizard build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules. Finished schedules in your format, with redrafts through the year included.

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard uses a team of mathematicians to distribute holiday call assignments equitably across all residents. Programs submit their rules (coverage requirements, resident preferences, ACGME duty hour rules, and fairness targets) and our team generates a finished schedule that balances high-demand dates like Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Year's across the resident cohort. Every assignment is algorithmically justified, giving chief residents a defensible answer to any fairness question.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard create a fair holiday call schedule for residency programs?

faq.answer: Yes. ACGME duty hour compliance is built into the schedule as it is created, not manually checked after the fact. Our team knows the subspecialty-specific ACGME rules, so the rules relevant to your program are built into the optimization. This includes the 80-hour weekly limit, eight hours off between duty periods, 14 hours free after 24-hour call, and the 24-hour cap, as well as any upcoming regulatory changes.
faq.question: Is the holiday call schedule ACGME compliant for my residency subspecialty?

faq.answer: Turnaround depends on your program's complexity and the rules submitted. Programs submit their scheduling rules to Scheduling Wizard, and the managed service handles the optimization and delivers a finished Excel file. Because our team handles the heavy computation, turnaround is significantly faster than building a holiday call schedule manually.
faq.question: How long does it take to receive a finished holiday call schedule?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard delivers finished schedules as Excel or Google Sheets files, and can build a custom live viewing link for your program if you want one. The files are ready to use immediately and can be uploaded directly to platform your program already uses, for day-to-day access by residents and attendings.
faq.question: What format is the holiday call schedule delivered in?

faq.answer: No. Scheduling Wizard is a managed service, not self-service software. Chief residents submit their program rules and receive a finished holiday call schedule back as an Excel file. There is no platform or dashboard to learn. This also means institutional scheduling knowledge persists with Scheduling Wizard year over year, so new chief residents don't start from scratch when they rotate into the role.
faq.question: Do chief residents need to learn new software to use Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: Yes. Resident preferences (including vacation requests, personal rules, and holiday availability) are treated as first-class inputs. They are factored into the schedule at generation time rather than being patched in manually after the core holiday call schedule is built, reducing conflicts and improving resident satisfaction.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard handle resident holiday preferences and vacation requests?
